explanation.description: Brief evidence-based summary: what was found, ambiguities, and why nulls were used. Write before filling promotions.

promotion_content.description: Each element is one bound offer card: service/package name, promo price or discount, and conditions in a single verbatim segment (use " | " between lines from the same card). Do not put membership monthly dues or member-tier perks here. Do not split prices onto separate bullets from the service name. No markdown links, image syntax, or Shopify Regular/Sale price UI. Extract every distinct limited-time promo on the page; omit catalog list prices and membership plans.
